eventLossConclusion: read-heavy-03: Determine why order events disappear after successful API responses

transactionFacts.statement: The order transaction commits before the outbox insert, so a crash between them returns a durable order with no event.
The publisher marks events sent only after publish, which can duplicate on crash but does not explain missing rows.

secondaryRisks: The metrics helper is unused and unrelated to event durability.
